title: area
summary: MSUI now publishes the current area family: leaf/top-zone identity, NEW_AREA/INDOORS/ordinary transition election, exact-key WMO default/group naming override, subzone-else-zone minimap line, CMSG_ZONEUPDATE, and friend-then-enemy PvP disposition plus arena leaf flag. The result feeds both the minimap label/tooltip and center-screen transition splashes.

openItems.text: No zone-change splash: entering a new zone/subzone never shows the big center-screen ZoneTextFont/SubZoneTextFont text (both fonts are declared in FontObjectLaw.cs but nothing renders a splash).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: The area transition feed now drives exact cached-text event gates and the ZoneText/SubZoneText fade renderer.

openItems.text: No WMO-interior naming: indoors the area stays the terrain chunk's - a named interior (Lion's Pride Inn whole-WMO override, per-room subzones like Main Hall, the indoor/outdoor dedup) never replaces the zone/subzone texts.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Interior naming now queries exact WMOAreaTable whole-WMO and hit-group rows, applies the default name/AreaTable fallback, resets the subzone on whole-WMO override, then restores a non-empty group room name.

openItems.text: No zone PvP info: friendly/hostile/contested ownership from the zone's FactionGroupMask vs the player's faction template (and the FFA-arena leaf flag) is not computed or displayed anywhere.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: AreaTable leaf Flags and zone FactionGroupMask now combine with the player's faction-template friend/enemy masks; the resulting friendly/hostile/contested/arena data is rendered on minimap and splash surfaces.

openItems.text: Focused law/source checks pass; live traversal verification remains for outdoor boundaries, whole-WMO inn overrides and named room groups.
